sourceNote: Production sources remained frozen throughout all four accepted windows. The example comparison links and final test/documentation edits followed timing; the runtime and world entry module hashes are unchanged.

environment.concurrency: No local builds, tests, encoders or source edits during accepted timing. Workstation background processes and clocks are not controlled.

methods: Optimized/default/optimized on the same production build, full 3-lap 108-second route. A separate loaded/warmed run records 12 seconds for each fixed view.
One unfinished composed GPU frame. FPS counts submissions, not monitor scanout. Earlier unfenced FPS is not comparable.
Natural lighting, Standard water with actual-context staging, terrain pixel error 2, unchanged placements, cull distances and LOD densities, full-detail Rapier collision.
Dynamic residency varies during traversal and can briefly reach zero after teleports. Fixed-view runs retain all selected residents; reported frame gains are not a guarantee of teleport coverage.
drawCalls is the actual per-frame draw count; frameRenderCalls counts composed/nested render calls. The older calls field in historical reports was cumulative render calls, not draw calls.
Stage durations include asynchronous waits. GPU render queries omit independent compute; CPU/GPU residency estimates omit driver allocations, worker heaps, host documents and post targets.

additionalNativeRegressionCoverage: spectral water compute and rendering (2 cases)

CI.head: 46f8dd63866cf26d9cc37b52404513d6249cb805
CI.note: Full Linux unit/lint/build and nine software-GPU browser cases. The final area-growth unit and second native world profile were added afterward and pass locally.

limitations: Opt-in profile and one pine asset; not default editor behavior, arbitrary material support, dense tropical acceptance, or CryEngine parity. Artist-facing optimization controls remain issue #17.

Two cards approximate the captured rest pose. No exact deep multi-layer parallax, individual leaf motion or camera-dependent card-history vectors. Conservative reactive history is used. No atlas mipmaps yet.
Default mesh foliage still misses frame p95. Wider draw cells can increase off-screen geometry and shadow work.
Atlas bytes reserve once per world; decoded source/base geometry and combined instance streams remain resident within cell/resource limits. This is not complete per-plant texture/geometry paging.
Renderer keeps the opaque capture on dry scenes: four RGBA16F attachments and depth add about 71.2 MiB at 1080p, in addition to composed pass/history targets.
Unused runtime programs are bounded by 64 programs / 8 MiB generated source text, excluding node graphs and driver storage. Renderer teardown releases the cache and tracked GPU allocations.
Two optimized runs and one default are local acceptance evidence with visible clock/load variability, not a universal FPS speedup estimate.

diagnostics.note: Rejected 80-triangle / 40-card prototype: rasterizing unused cards increased GPU cost. Superseded by four vertex-oriented triangles.
Four-triangle impostors + 64 m near groups, 32 unused programs: met global frame p95 but failed the 250 ms pause limit on forest return.
64 unused programs + 64 m near groups: below 250 ms, still failed frame p95.
64 m near groups without impostors: below 250 ms, still failed frame p95.
